name: screencapture-pro
description: A modern screen recorder for Windows 10 and 11.
author: ScreenCapture Pro

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron -c cyan,yellow,magenta "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.selftest: npm run build && cross-env SCP_SELFTEST=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs
